`LayerNode` deps. This fixes typecheck (0) AND the `AppRuntime`-before-initialization TDZ that

KNOWN REGRESSION (next to fix): bootstrap-heavy paths HANG. `bun test
test/project/instance-bootstrap.test.ts` hangs (was a fast TDZ error at ckpt34); the headless
`run` command boots through db-migrations then hangs before the agent loop (both Ollama + Azure,
EXIT after timeout, no output past migrations). Root-cause hypothesis: Layer.suspend OVER-applied
-> layer-build deadlock during AppLayer construction, likely via per-module makeRuntime runtimes
sharing memoMap with non-memoized suspended layers rebuilding. Isolation proven: stashing these
edits removes the hang (reverts to the fast TDZ). Fix = bisect which suspend(s) deadlock / fix the

Committing as WIP so the typecheck+TDZ progress isn't lost while the hang is diagnosed from a clean base.
